info.name: Bean Fien — ChaserXHype API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Bean Fien backend. Base URL: http://localhost:5000/api/v1

**Auth:** Most routes require a Bearer JWT token.
Set the `accessToken` collection variable after calling POST /auth/login.

**Roles:** USER · ADMIN · BARISTA

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Authentication — login, register, OTP, token refresh, password management

request.description: Returns accessToken + refreshToken. Copy accessToken into the `accessToken` collection variable.
Get a new access token using a valid refresh token.

item.name: 👤 User
item.description: User registration and profile management

request.description: Public endpoint. Accepts multipart/form-data for profile image upload.
AUTH: USER or ADMIN. Accepts multipart/form-data.
AUTH: ADMIN. Values: ACTIVE | BLOCKED | DELETED

AUTH: USER or ADMIN. For coin products set isCoinProduct: true and use coinProductId instead of productId.
AUTH: USER or ADMIN. Removes all items from cart.

item.name: 📦 Orders
item.description: Order checkout, management, status updates, tips, and refunds

request.description: AUTH: USER or ADMIN. Places order from current cart. Returns Stripe checkout URL for CARD payments.
AUTH: USER or ADMIN. Returns order list including assignedBarista info.

query.description: PENDING | CONFIRMED | PREPARING | READY | COMPLETED | CANCELED

request.description: AUTH: BARISTA or ADMIN. Returns orders assigned to the currently authenticated barista.
AUTH: ADMIN or BARISTA. Valid statuses: PENDING | CONFIRMED | PREPARING | READY | OUT_FOR_DELIVERY | COMPLETED | CANCELED | FAILED
AUTH: USER or ADMIN. Adds a gratuity tip to a completed order. amount must be > 0.

query.description: Number of past days to include

request.description: AUTH: ADMIN. Returns KPIs, daily breakdown, and barista leaderboard.

request.description: No auth. Receives Stripe events. Do not call manually in production.

item.description: Barista profile management, order assignment, and claiming

request.description: AUTH: BARISTA or ADMIN. Returns profile + today's metrics.
AUTH: BARISTA or ADMIN. Barista self-claims an unassigned order.
AUTH: ADMIN. Creates a barista account (role: BARISTA).
AUTH: ADMIN. If baristaId omitted, auto-assigns best available barista.

request.description:

Moods: Stressed | Energetic | Happy | Chill | Sleepy | Focused
temperature: HOT | COLD | BOTH

No auth required. NLP-powered product filtering from natural language queries.
No auth required. Pass conversationHistory to maintain multi-turn context.
AUTH: USER, ADMIN, or BARISTA. Admin sees all history; users see their own.
